【H】【E】【Y】

That said, let's check what's [b]new(™)[/b].

[u][b]Play Button:[/b][/u] A [b]new(™)[/b] shortcut leading to the mode selection. This will improve the flow, especially for 2v2 matches.

[u][b]Perk system:[/b][/u] We're trying out a [b]new(™)[/b] feature to improve the game’s flow, especially the queue times. This system will empower players with lower skill levels to make matches challenging for more experienced players - positively impacting newcomers without negatively affecting veterans. While you grab your torches, remember we can iterate or even revert certain parts of it. 

The Perk System is going to kick in when two players with a significant rank difference are matched together. Depending on the difference, the lower-ranked player is going to be randomly given one or several passive cards from a pool that are active throughout the match. notes.title: Buddy’s Bulletin: XV, September 15th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/42d1bd5c5208dc12970bf4a3e829151ccca7db2d.png[/img]

Howdy Friends,

How are you enjoying the Free Weekend? It's been so great to see Friendtown fill up with new faces, read your Friends vs Friends reviews and hear your excitement for all the updates and changes. Be sure to keep leaving us your reviews, take some time to try out the game and, maybe if you like what you see, consider picking it up. It's never been cheaper and there's never been a better time to play. 

You may have also seen that we gave you a glimpse into the future yesterday with Wired Wrecks. We're going to dedicate today's bulletin to answering your questions about what's happening this October, how you can get hold of our first Premium Expansion, and why it's going to be the greatest thing to ever happen to Friendtown. Since opening, of course. 

[previewyoutube=2quej-wdJ9o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Reveals of the Week[/h2]

Let's break this down for you...

[b]What is Wired Wrecks?[/b]

Why, it's the first of two Premium Expansions confirmed for release in 2023 for Friends vs Friends. 

[b]How much will it cost?[/b]

For now, it's only included as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432020/Friends_vs_Friends_Deluxe_Edition_Content/]Friends vs Friends Deluxe Edition.[/url] which is bundled alongside Premium Expansion 2. We are also looking into selling this seperately ahead of launch. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432020/Friends_vs_Friends_Deluxe_Edition_Content/

[b]When is it coming out?[/b]

Wired Wrecks will be releasing in early October. We'll have a final release date for you [b]VERY SOON! [/b]

[b]What's included in Wired Wrecks?[/b]

Within the Premium Expansion, you'll get the following

[list]
[*] 10 Card Backs
[*] 10 Hama (Key) Chains
[*] 5 New Skins 
[/list]

[b]Are KlustR Jr. and the 5 new cards also included?[/b]

The new character and cards will be made available as part of a free update (for everyone who owns Friends vs Friends) around the launch of Wired Wrecks. You do not need to pay to play as KlustR Jr or use the new cards.

[b]Wait, the new character will be free?[/b]

Yep! Although if you do pick up Wired Wrecks, you'll get 2 additional skins for KlustR Jr to give him some slightly different looks. 

[b]How about the Hyena, they look really cool.[/b]

Racco is super cool and you can find out a whoooole lot more about them in Wired Wrecks. Invites are open to their Workshop.

[b]What's happening with Premium Expansion 2?[/b]

That's also due to release in 2023. We're not quite ready to talk about this one yet but let's just say you can expect similar (and also VERY different) things to Wired Wrecks.

[b]Oh, and how are those console releases cooking?[/b]

They're cooking! 

Hope we answered everything! But if we didn't, just let us know below and we'll be sure to reply. 

[h2]Community Spotlight[/h2]

We're already getting fanart for KlustR Jr. Our newest Friend seems to have won over many hearts and we're so excited to share them with you. 

Thanks for sketching this midofox96 from our Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/2e62ebb739b5c6fed49fc209ae26cd0db0415c4c.png[/img]

Thank you for sharing all your fan art with us. If you've been making some for Friends vs Friends, why not submit it to the fan art [url=https://awardsconceptartassociation.awardsplatform.com/]category here?[/url] We've seen some fantastic pieces out there and some surely worthy winners.

[h2]Special Shoutouts[/h2]

We've got two very special shoutouts we want to make in today's Bulletin.

Firstly, we're super grateful for the support from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658150/Moonstone_Island/]Moonstone Island[/url] team yesterday as they gave our Free Weekend a massive push across their networks. Thank you so much for connecting with us and telling the world about what's happening in Friendtown. You won't want to miss [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658150/Moonstone_Island/]Moonstone Island[/url] when it releases on Steam next week, September 20! Especially since they also love some deck-building action. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658150/Moonstone_Island/

Secondly, if you're loving Friends vs Friends and everything the Brainwash Gang are getting up to, then check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796220/Laika_Aged_Through_Blood/]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/url], a Western-Inspired Motorvania that you might spot some references to in Friends vs Friends. You've never explored a post-apocalyptic wasteland quite like this before.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796220/Laika_Aged_Through_Blood/

[h2]Mayor’s Message[/h2]

Hey folks, it's me. The Mayor of Friendtown. 

Sorry I can't stop for long, this Free Weekend is certainly keeping me on my toes. Everyone's asking for free drinks. Free food. Heck, I've had people asking if they can stay at my place for free. You know, I'd probably let them if they bring me my favourite packet of crisps but that would sort of be defeating the point of 'free' wouldn't it....

It's been so nice connecting with so many wonderful people, some discovering Friendtown for the first time, others coming back for a return visit. We hope you'll stick around and stay with us. 

I'd also encourage each and every one of you reading this to tell just one friend about the Free Weekend. Share the love far and wide and let's really take over this...'Steam' place. Whatever that is.

Oh, and if you have stopped by and checked out Friends vs Friends, do take some time to leave us a review. It really helps us to grow, develop and expand, and let's us know what we're getting right. And equally, what we're getting wrong.

Right, better get back to it. Someone's currently moving their sofa into my house and looks like a weekend's supply of munchies. Perhaps if they're willing to share?

That's been me, the Mayor of Friendtown. And you're reading the Mayor's Message. 

 - The Mayor of Friendtown

notes.title: Buddy’s Bulletin: XIII, August 25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/b9394fe69e57f2e4d7627b7b57879a695cce8b6a.png[/img]

Hi Friends,

Summer might nearly be over but as far as Friends vs Friends goes, the future remains bright.

We begin a series of exciting updates this week, telling you a little bit more about what's coming up in the Ranked Mode! But you can also expect plenty more big news in the next couple of Buddy's Bulletins as the road to Premium Expansion 1 begins! 

Here we go...

[h2]Reveal of the Week[/h2]

As announced last week, Ranked is coming to Friends vs Friends in the next few weeks! We know this has been one of the most highly requested features since launch and we won't keep you waiting too much longer. 

Before we get there, here are a few key facts for you to be aware of...

[list]
[*] This is being layered on top of the existing matchmaking system in Friends vs Friends and when added into the game will be the default way to play. 
[*] After completing a match, your own individual performance is measured, as well as the differences between you and your rivals. This will enable you to 'rank up', presented by a visual reward in-game.
[*]The above point will also go some way to addressing another key issue people have cited from launch - not being matched with someone of an equivalent skill level. 
[*] Any unlockables, wins and losses you currently have are carried over. 
[*] There will be 16 different ranks, spread across 6 tiers.
[*] To move up a rank, you'll need to have earned enough points over a sustained period of time to progress. Be careful, though, you can also lose points through your post-match performance and even your ranking. 
[*] You will be able to see a player's ranking and tier in their profile picture. 
[*] Ranked Stats will also be viewable via a menu in-game, documenting details such as Packs Opened, Headshots Performed, Most Used Card and Favourite Friend.
[/list]

How does all of that sound? If you've got questions, feel free to drop them below and we'll answer what we can!

[h2]Community Spotlight[/h2]

Here's a cool new look for Haru who might just be enjoying the Island life a bit too much! Big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/RaposoG1/status/1690149510255980544/photo/1]Cindy [/url]for sharing this with us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/dac15d6bca3216af925036239bc7d080e0ccfa2a.jpg[/img]

Thank you for sharing all your fan art with us. If you've been making some for Friends vs Friends, why not submit it to the fan art [url=https://awardsconceptartassociation.awardsplatform.com/]category here?[/url] We've seen some fantastic pieces out there and some surely worthy winners.

[h2]Mayor’s Message[/h2]

Hey folks, it's me. The Mayor of Friendtown. I don't pretend to understand all this talk of ranks and stats but I know that excites quite a lot of people around here, so that also excites me too.

It actually reminds me of a time when my dear sister got a pack of cards one birthday. I didn't understand the appeal at all, I'd never played and wondered how they could possibly be fun. But now I surround myself with cards and have the best days of my life because of them! Life sure has a sense of humor, at times.

Maybe that will be true of all these big changes coming through, too. After all, change is important and vital for growth, even if it's not always clear how that change will work out or if you think it'll be right for you.

Hoo, hoo, this is all getting rather deep and profound, isn't it? I find myself quite reflective these Summer days. I think the sun is going to my head and giving it some fuel to work overtime. Who knows?

For now, and until next time, that’s been me, the Mayor of Friendtown - and you’ve been reading the Mayor’s Message. 

 - The Mayor of Friendtown

We want to be producing Buddy's Bulletins years from now, making sure to keep our community updated and invested in Friends vs Friends for a long time. To help us out, if you've got a specific issue you feel needs addressing or want to see a particular feature added, drop us a comment below or keep the discussion flowing in the Steam forums. notes.title: Game Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello, Friends!

Remember when we mentioned on Monday that we're working on the matchmaking system? Well, we've got some news to share! This is our first attempt to tackle some of the issues players have been reporting, and we'll keep fine-tuning the matchmaking to make it the absolute best it can be.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Content & Features[/h3]

[list]
[b]Matchmaking[/b]
[*] Improved level-based matchmaking: Improved chances of finding matches with players on at a similar level as you & fixed an issue when a party is created and enters the 2v2 queue
[/list]
[list]
[b]UI Updates[/b]
[*] Added controller binding to the "Invite Friend" shortcut
[*] Improved UI navigation with controller
[*] Rich text is disabled in nickname tags so that players can't change colors/format
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Out of bounds & occlusion issues in Subway Station
[*] Fixed: The first voted map is always the picked map for the rematch
[*] Fixed: Friends & "Recently played with" widgets in the Friends menu get mixed up & unsorted after a few seconds
[*] Fixed: "There's nothing to lose at this point" can't be obtained
[*] Fixed: The Self-Destruct card explosion didn’t do any damage, now it does! 
[*] Fixed: Bots on Rooftop stay defensive
[*] Fixed: There was a bug where all explosive quests didn’t work as intended
[*] Fixed: Removed the movie playing on the Theatre's screen to avoid random crashes
[/list]

[h3]Issues with matchmaking in Australian regions[/h3]

Additionally, we've received numerous reports about high ping issues & incorrect 'best regions' from users based in Australia. We've been going through this issue with our multiplayer server provider and found out that this issue is, for now, exclusive to all players who have internet provided by the company Optus, or any ISP that relays on the Optus network.

If that's your case, we're terribly sorry, but there's not much we can do on our side. We can tell you about some workarounds some of you found, though!

1. Using Cloudflare WARP. You can access it here: https://1.1.1.1 (it looks shady but we promise it's not!). It's free, so give it a shot if you don't have access to a paid VPN service!

2. Using Optus Game Path. You can access it here: https://www.optus.com.au/broadband-nbn/gaming-internet-plans/game-path

3. Using any VPN service of your choosing. Since the issue is how the Optus network reroutes the connection to our Australia server, this should potentially fix the high ping, no matter the service you use.

Again, we're sorry about this, and we hope these solutions can help you enjoy Friends vs Friends with us ❤️

Until next time!

- Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury

notes.title: Cards (and how to use them)
notes.content:
Howdy, Friends!

Because we reckin' you know how to shoot (or, at least, we hope you do) no need to cover that here - but let's make sure you know how to play your cards right, shall we?

Ask Little Lars (our giant but gentle polar bear) and they'll tell you how important deck management is in Friends vs Friends. This is why you need to balance your deck and make sure you're getting the most out of your hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/688b57b7b10736d5345b45c1f4151cfb12e3e31c.jpg[/img]

There are all sorts of cards to choose from. Give your opponent a Big Head to make it easier to headshot them. Use vampire bullets to steal enemy health. Put down a turret to help defend you. There's even a Nuke card so you can wipe the map. You'll start your battle with 6 cards, but that doesn't mean you'll know what hand your opponent is holding so you'll need to build a mix of offensive, defensive, and weapon cards to make sure you come out on top.

Cards have positive impacts on you and your prospects of victory, but there are also negatively affecting cards that can reduce your accuracy, change bullets into rubber, and even poison you. There are even some rare cards that can be complete game-changers if you have them in your deck, like a mimic card which actually gives you the same ability as your opponent. Using those cards combined with a teammate in 2v2, well that can just about turn around the tide of any battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/d45cd2b27354e1c2c62bd38a16fd75534a07044d.jpg[/img]

Cards can be boosted by opening card packs (earned through playing matches - winning gets your extra bucks!) and getting that card's double. The more doubles you obtain, the more powerful that card will be! Cash Crumbs (our shopkeeper with a certain "charm") will definitely be pleased to help you part with your money (in-game, of course, no pay-to-win here!)

You don't have long to think about the cards you want to take into battle with you as Friends vs Friends launches on May 30th! Wishlist now so you don't miss it, friend-o.

- Brainwash Gang

notes.title: Matchmaking!
notes.content:
Howdy, Friends!

You’re gonna be hearing a lot more from us now we’re getting close to launch and wanna make sure you’re super-duper prepared for everything and anything right out of the gate. Like how to matchmake, for instance. That’s pretty important in Friends vs Friends. Y’know, considering that’s what we’re all about. Don’t worry though, we’re going to show you how to do it in a few easy steps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/f86efa2ad76bd80c614c50fb3921becbb3d171c0.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The game is built around 1v1 and 2v2 matches, so that means you won’t be waiting around in queues for an age  — There’s always someone spoiling for a fight around these parts!

[*]While you're wandering around the hub, you can easily jump into a queue at any time by hopping on the bus and, if you're feeling bold, join the standard queues for each match type. The matchmaking system will line you up with someone around your level so you can test your skills.

[*]If you're looking to settle a score with your siblings or your buddy wants to prove they've got your back, you can hop into a Private Match and take them on head to head or side by side. You'll generate a code that you can pass to your enemy/friend to make sure you're playing together.

[*]Practice makes perfect, so if you're finding you're a bit rusty with the old FK-82, you can dive into a session with bots to sharpen those skills (and katana, if you're so inclined).  If you want to test out specific weapons, head to the basement of the diner to use the firing range!

[*]We recommend you experiment with your deck, make changes, and try to find the most effective combination of cards to suit how you wanna play!
[/list]

Stay tuned for more tips and tricks before Friends vs Friends launches on May 30th! Get on our wishlist to make sure you don't miss a single update!

- Brainwash Gang

notes.title: Let's get to The Hub!

Well, howdy, folks! We’re just a few weeks away from launch and there’s still so much we want to tell you! Let's start with a little peak of The Hub, aka [b]Buddy's Boulevard[/b], shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/9962852a0edd25b2ad31cb843e38685b67188174.jpg[/img]

...Wait, what do you mean you’ve never heard of The Hub? Did you miss all the leaks on the FvF socials? It’s the place to be! The Hub is your customization destination in between matching with your friends, your enemies, and everyone else in between. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/10c0c3298235e833c4070594708ca7fb237fa8f7.jpg[/img]

We’ve got a lovely little diner where you can hang out, look out the windows, admire the fish tank, and check out your cards! This is [i]the[/i] spot to start making your deck of choice. Study your cards, make changes, experiment with combos, and tweak in perfect safety, all while watching the world (and its traffic) go by outside. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/40713378b23d19c76e67ec82068985c009759e1b.jpg[/img]

Nancy, the Diner's waitstaff, is ready to dish you up daily and weekly quests alongside their famous blueberry pie.

Cash will be eagerly waiting to sell you new card booster packs with your hard-earned "Friendo" bucks! If you get some new weapons, be sure to try them out in the firing range in the same room. Just find your favorite armament and take out some of those frustrations on pop-up cardboard. Don't worry, it has it coming. 

If you swing by the bathroom, you'll be able to check out the character selection screen in case you want to try a new Friend (or even just dress them up in your hard-earned character skins!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/13758c9904bce2f23a26dc5af808566ad2d96ee4.jpg[/img]

You’ll also notice some empty outlets while wandering around. That’s because there are still a few places waiting to open — the good news is they won’t stay empty for long! Content drops and Expansions will be heading your way soon after launch to give The Hub a major facelift!  Stay tuned in June when we show off what will be available for the first few major updates.

Fortunately, YOU won’t have to wait much longer to visit to The Hub as Friends vs Friends launches on May 30! Slap us a wishlist, will ya?

Until next time, Friends!
